campaigns.name: GTAVI Launch Celebration
campaigns.summary: Unlock six Bling Badge viewership badges by watching GTAVI streamers for one hour each day on six different days between November 18–30. Subscribe three times to streamers in the GTAVI Category between November 18–30 to earn our full “Heist” collection of six additional sub badges and emotes. If you earn every emote and badge in the Bling Badge and Heist Collections, you’ll unlock the rare Golden Iguana Badge.

Summary: Disclaimer: Pokémon Night Out Themed Poke Balls must be opened within 30 days of the campaign ending. Pokémon First Partners Campaign and Night Out Campaign evolutions must be completed by January 30, 2027.

Participating categories include: Pokémon FireRed/LeafGreen, Pokémon Pokopia, Pokémon UNITE, Pokémon Champions, Pokémon GO, Pokémon Legends: Z-A, Pokémon Scarlet/Violet, Pokémon Trading Card Game, Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket, Pokémon Trading Card Game Live, Pokémon: Diamond/Pearl, Just Chatting, DJs, Art, Special Events, Sports, Music, Talk Shows & Podcasts, Animals/Aquariums/Zoos, Co-working & Studying, Makers & Crafting
